decisions.reason: Full-page placement does not change the existing aspect-ratio or cropping quality constraints.
Image placement does not change the permitted source, review requirement, or suitability criteria for chapter illustrations.
Full-page image placement does not alter the typography or semantic role of the Chapter 18 first line.
The source concerns chapter-image placement and does not change the cover image count, cover presentation, or trim size.
Chapter-image placement has no effect on the copyright-page publication attribution.
Formatting chapter images as full pages does not change the authoritative manuscript text or tracked editorial content.
Chapter-image placement does not affect the approved title text or its newline-marker constraint.
Although full-page images may influence eventual pagination, the requirement to update table-of-contents page numbers after fixing the book size remains valid unchanged.
Chapter-image placement does not change the required back matter or author biography content.
Full-page chapter-image presentation does not change the paperback publication format or the established 6 x 9-inch trim size.
